split.strategy: stratified, grouped by identity component (union-find over filename ids)

notes: Fake filenames 'AAA_BBB.mp4' involve two source identities; both are unioned into one split component to prevent identity leakage.
No audio tracks are used; audio detector training is out of scope for this sample (documented as future work).
